raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be the worst supplier for on-time delivery"
  role subject "Farmexim"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "Management"

@s2 stated
  relation "want to drop from the framework"
  role subject "Management"
  role object "Farmexim"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "the October review"

@a1 assumed
  relation "have problems with on-time delivery"
  role subject "the Cluj depot"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
  valid during "the summer"

@a2 assumed
  relation "have problems with on-time delivery"
  role subject "the Iasi depot"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
  valid during "the summer"

@a3 assumed
  relation "deliver late"
  role subject "other suppliers"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
  valid during "the summer"

@q query
  select ?s
  where all
    match
      relation "deliver late"
      role subject ?s
      polarity affirmed
      valid during "this year"
    end
  end
  rank ?s highest
  compare ?count above ?farmexim_count
